Oh, what a gloomy day it's been! Though I suppose any day is a good day to chat about 80s new wave bands and classic sci-fi cinema.

The band Duran Duran took their name from the 1968 film **Barbarella**, directed by Roger Vadim and starring Jane Fonda. In the movie, Duran Duran is the name of the main villain, Dr. Durand-Durand (sometimes spelled as one word), an evil scientist played by Milo O'Shea. The band members were fans of the campy, psychedelic sci-fi film and adopted the character's name for their group when they formed in Birmingham in 1978.
